name: The Prophet
source:
The commander-in-chief of Eclipse

[i]"My only choice is to sin to survive and lay bare my sins before our great Mother."[/i]

As the only person capable of hearing the voice of [b]La[/b], the creator of all things, she is revered and venerated as the [b]Spokesperson of the Sun God[/b] by all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3280020/Eclipse__Special_Forces/]Steam[/url]]
